_comment: MostWanted's game server, for Raptor (or any Pterodactyl/Pelican panel). Import it on the Eggs page: docs/12-launch.md.
name: MostWanted
author: contact@xenastudios.co
description: The MostWanted game server: Leaf, every plugin we use (pinned and checksummed), our configs and the core plugin, from the latest build of github.com/xena-studios/mostwanted. Reinstall to update. Needs a database on its Databases tab.

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# MostWanted's game server: the latest build (the "server" release, from main), put
# in place by its own server/install.sh: Leaf and every plugin pinned in its
# manifest, checksums checked, and the configs. The world and plugin data stay.
# Reinstall in Raptor to update. Settings are filled in at each start (start.sh).
set -euo pipefail
apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl jq perl ca-certificates >/dev/null
work=$(mktemp -d)
curl -fsSL -o "$work/server.tar.gz" "https://github.com/xena-studios/mostwanted/releases/download/${RELEASE}/mostwanted-server.tar.gz"
tar -xzf "$work/server.tar.gz" -C "$work"
echo "MostWanted build $(cat "$work/COMMIT")"
bash "$work/server/install.sh" /mnt/server
rm -f /mnt/server/plugins/core-*.jar
cp "$work/core.jar" /mnt/server/plugins/MostWanted.jar
rm -rf "$work"
echo "Installed. Before the first start: a database on the Databases tab, and the settings on the Startup tab."

variables.name: Build
variables.description: Which build to install: a release on github.com/xena-studios/mostwanted. "server" is always the latest from main. Reinstall to get it.

variables.name: Join through Minehut
variables.description: true: players join through Minehut only (launch). false: direct connections to this server's address, for testing before Minehut is set up. Restart after changing it.

variables.name: Tebex secret key
variables.description: The webstore's secret key, so the server delivers purchases (Tebex: Integrations → Game servers). "none" until the store is set up.

variables.name: LuckPerms storage
variables.description: postgresql: the server's database. h2 only for a test without one.

variables.name: LibertyBans database
variables.description: POSTGRES: the server's database. HSQLDB only for a test without one.
